static_traits.name: Lin Wei
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with colleagues are affected; feels lonely at work
static_traits.medical_history: Has not received psychotherapy or psychiatric treatment; no major physical illness; no similar past problems
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperation, steady tone; under guidance can distinguish 'worry' from 'fact' and attempt reframing; self-evaluation tends to be harsh

basic_info.main_problem: I persistently feel overwhelmed by reading pressure and fear I will never catch up with my reading; the problem has developed into avoiding reading; it worsens whenever I see new books or fall behind my reading plan.
basic_info.core_demands: Hopes to reduce the feeling of being crushed by reading and the pressure of reading, to enjoy work again, and no longer feel overwhelmed.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / I am a failure
Only by finishing enough new books and keeping up with the pace at all times do I count as competent and valuable

special_situations.event: A new batch of books arrives at the bookstore
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot finish reading all these new books as soon as possible, it means I am incompetent and will be left behind
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sets higher / more reading goals, forcing the self to speed up to prove the self
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I simply cannot finish reading; I will be overwhelmed

special_situations.event: Discovering oneself falling behind the set reading plan
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I fall behind it equals failure, showing I am not suited for this job
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Breaks plans into finer detail and self-chastises, or simply avoids reading to relieve stress in the short term

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not read the book they mentioned, others will judge me as unprofessional
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces communication with colleagues, avoiding discussion to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一定在觉得我not专业

special_situations.event: Occasionally forgetting to read a book or missing some content
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once an oversight occurs, I can never catch up again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries working overtime to catch up on reading or avoids reading entirely to relieve anxiety

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized as competent, accepted by colleagues, and have a sense of belonging
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being judged as not good enough, excluded, and losing face
defense_goal: Gaining control and recognition by setting high standards
Avoiding reading and socializing when feeling incompetent and ashamed to reduce anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: An employee who is not good enough and could be exposed at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks 'what evidence is there that others are judging you?' or discusses colleagues' views
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feels they are being scrutinized and judged, that others (or the counselor) will discover they are not capable
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Hesitant tone, uses vague expressions (such as 'they probably...'), avoids expressing subjective feelings, and instead emphasizes external pressure and others' opinions.

manifestations: At work, distancing from colleagues, avoiding reading discussions, feeling isolated and helpless

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: The internal rule is 'must finish reading all new books to count as competent'
Treats 'qualified employee = has read everything' as an absolute standard

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Self-rating as 'I failed / I am not good enough'
Overly cautious for fear of being judged; reduces communication with colleagues
In narration, easily treating worries as facts

positive_force: Has motivation to seek help and is willing to try cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments
Possesses some self-observation ability, able to realize 'worries may not be facts'
Has a small number of friends to confide in
Passionate about work, willing to improve professional ability
negative_force: Sets unrealistic reading goals and perfectionistic standards
Marked cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, mind reading, and all-or-nothing thinking
Relieving anxiety in the short term by avoiding reading and socializing, maintaining the problem cycle
Excessively ties self-worth to work and reading output
Sleep affected, physical and mental resources decline

antecedent: Realizing one has fallen behind the reading plan
After work, thinking about needing to catch up on reading
target_behavior.core_reason: The rigid belief that 'falling behind = failure' and catastrophic predictions, together with worry about being judged by colleagues, trigger strong anxiety
target_behavior.function: Escaping anxiety and potential negative evaluation, gaining short-term emotional relief
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance, anxiety persists and worsens, sleep affected

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding reading discussions with colleagues at work (social withdrawal)
antecedent: A colleague starts a book-related discussion
The team shares views on a new book
target_behavior.core_reason: Projecting self-criticism as others' judgment, fearing exposure of 'I am not good enough'
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible shame and negative evaluation
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged interpersonal relationships, increased loneliness, reduced career learning opportunities
